sections_reviewed: Section 2 and 2.3: channel and per-packet queue/deadline model
Section 9 and endnote c: scope, idealization and deadline feasibility
verified_title: Individual packet deadline delay constrained opportunistic scheduling for large multiuser systems
method_summary: A channel-aware threshold scheduler uses individual packet waiting/deadline states. A Markov formulation and many-user limit support energy optimization; packet deadlines and queue ages enter the controller explicitly.
evidence_and_limits: Idealized multiple-access scheduling with capacity-region coding, asymptotic user count, and sufficient power; endnote c explicitly notes shadowing/power limits can make deadline guarantees infeasible. This is not learned partial-observation Wi-Fi roaming, and its no-drop assumption cannot be transferred to physical handover outages.
